title: Connecting Wixel directly to the phone usb for Dexcom G4
body:
It will be possible with xDrip+ to add data directly from Wixel only by USB connection?
When connect Wixel to OTG USB port and use USB terminal all datas are available for Dexcom G4.
http://photouploads.com/image/TbV

comments.body:
It is possible using a program called dexterity.
What you will need to do is to connect dexterity to the usb port and have
it read the data.
That done, you need to tell xDrip to take the data form dexterity.

But do you really want to connect the wixel to a phone? How will you charge
the phone?
